status: frozen before any R1 outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 R1: encoding-to-instability replication and transport
scope: Fresh replication/transport branch testing whether the inherited labeled-scaffold E0-only prose-versus-fields prior-state encoding contrast on T_instability is stable across four independently sampled prestate cohorts from the same sampling distribution. R1 does not continue the A-series localization ladder and does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A4c: legacy-versus-canonical inline rendering causal on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A5: labeled-scaffold prose-versus-fields encoding produced Delta_R_instability=+0.0207 with 95% CI inside +/-0.05
lineage.A6: section scaffold practically small for T_instability
lineage.A7: encoding x scaffold interaction practically small for T_instability; within-A7 prose-minus-fields instability contrasts were approximately +0.0556 labeled and +0.0476 unlabeled
lineage.R1_object: replicate/transport the labeled-scaffold E0-only encoding-to-instability contrast across independently sampled prestates
lineage.A_series: localization branch stopped; no A8 finer-formatting ablation

cohort_sampling.definition: four independently sampled sets of MMLU-Pro frozen prestates drawn with the same sampler and raw_n, using distinct prespecified sample seeds
cohort_sampling.disjointness: each later R1 cohort excludes all earlier R1 cohort task files in addition to every prior Pilot 0 task set, so no prestate may appear in more than one R1 cohort
cohort_sampling.interpretation: same manipulation, assay, model, generation contract, and prestate-sampling distribution; different sampled prestates

invariants.conversation_topology: one labeled user message -> assistant answer prefill

fixed_scaffold.signal_section:

encoding.R_fields:
ANSWER: <exact frozen initial answer>
P_CORRECT: <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals>
encoding.R_prose: Your previous answer was <exact frozen initial answer>. Before feedback, you assigned probability <exact frozen p_correct rendered to six decimals> that this answer was correct.

manipulation.causal_object: prose versus field/value encoding of the same prior answer and P_CORRECT inside the exact inherited labeled E0 scaffold
not_authorized_as: cohort heterogeneity merely because cohort point estimates differ

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create four branch units per eligible prestate and randomize RF_E0/RP_E0 within block with exact 2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id and cohort id fix a prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'r1::' + cohort_id + '::' + branch_id); encoding label never enters the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same assignment and seed rules apply in every cohort. No claim of shared realized randomness across encodings or cohorts is made.

primary_endpoint.name: T_instability
primary_endpoint.definition: within one encoding arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
primary_endpoint.cohort_estimand: Delta_c = mean_i D_i within cohort c
primary_endpoint.common_estimand: Delta_common = arithmetic mean of the four prespecified cohort effects Delta_1...Delta_4; cohorts receive equal weight as independent replication draws

analysis.cohort_reporting: report Delta_c and a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval for every cohort before pooled inference
analysis.common_effect_interval: stratified whole-block bootstrap: independently resample blocks with replacement within each cohort, recompute Delta_c, then average the four cohort effects equally
analysis.common_effect_test: two-sided blocked randomization test for Delta_common=0 under the sharp no-encoding-effect null: within every prestate block, shuffle RF_E0/RP_E0 labels preserving exact 2/2, recompute each cohort Delta_c and their equal-cohort mean
analysis.common_effect_practical_scale: practical equivalence requires the 95% stratified-bootstrap interval for Delta_common to lie strictly inside [-0.05,+0.05]
transport_assessment_order: between-cohort dispersion relative to estimated sampling uncertainty
analysis.transport_model: Cochran Q common-effect compatibility diagnostic using cohort-specific sampling variances Var(D_i)/n_c; report Q, df=3, chi-square p-value, I^2, and DerSimonian-Laird tau^2 descriptively
analysis.transport_guard: if any cohort has zero/nonfinite estimated sampling variance, mark Q/I2/tau2 not adjudicable rather than regularizing silently
analysis.transport_interpretation: Q p>=0.05 means observed cohort effects are compatible with a common-effect model under this diagnostic; it does not establish transport invariance. Q p<0.05 is evidence of excess between-cohort dispersion and earns a transport/heterogeneity follow-up.

common_effect.ENCODING_INSTABILITY_WEAKENED_AT_A2_SCAL: p>=0.05 and the 95% common-effect interval lies strictly inside [-0.05,+0.05]

transport.BETWEEN_COHORT_VARIATION_SIGNAL: Cochran Q p<0.05 when transport diagnostic is adjudicable
transport.COMPATIBLE_WITH_COMMON_EFFECT: Cochran Q p>=0.05 when adjudicable; not evidence of perfect invariance
transport.TRANSPORT_NOT_ADJUDICABLE: sampling-variance requirements for Q are not met

interpretation_guardrails: R1 is a replication/transport branch, not continuation of the A-series localization ladder.
T_instability is the sole primary endpoint because R1 prospectively targets the A5-A7 replication discrepancy.
Different cohort point estimates do not by themselves establish heterogeneity.
Failure to detect between-cohort variation does not establish perfect transport invariance.
A significant common effect does not imply a practically large effect; causal/nonzero and practical-scale claims remain separate.
A transport signal does not identify why cohorts differ; prestate composition, sampling variation beyond model assumptions, or other context dependence require later discrimination.
No R1 result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS.
